description: Defines classes and interfaces for V4L2 decode surfaces used in video decoding, including reference counting, metadata management, and control submission.

classes.name: V4L2DecodeSurface
classes.description: Abstract class representing a V4L2 decode surface with metadata and control methods.

classes.name: V4L2RequestDecodeSurface
classes.description: Concrete implementation of V4L2DecodeSurface that uses V4L2 requests for control and buffer management.

methods.name: SetDecoded
methods.description: Marks the surface as decoded and releases reference surfaces.

methods.name: SetVisibleRect
methods.description: Sets the visible rectangle of the surface.

methods.name: SetColorSpace
methods.description: Sets the color space metadata for the surface.

methods.name: SetDecodeDoneCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be called after decoding is finished.

methods.name: SetReleaseCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be called when the surface is released.

methods.name: PrepareSetCtrls
methods.description: Prepares control structures for V4L2 control submission.

methods.name: GetReferenceID
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for referencing this frame.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits the control and buffer request for decoding.
